verdict.rationale: Vue.js is an open-source, MIT-licensed client library that ships as a downloadable script or npm package with no vendor-hosted service required — community evidence explicitly confirms you can 'download vue(.min).js' with no package manager or bundler needed, meaning the entire core product runs on infrastructure you control by default. Missing for 10: no explicit vendor documentation framing 'self-hosting' as a deployment option (since there's no SaaS alternative to self-host against), and no independent audit of build/runtime self-hosting at scale.
